# KKACHI Black ICE One-Page Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** Replace every KKACHI page with one dark, ls.bot-like page at `/kkachi/` that uses Neuromancer line art and motifs, with nacre as the only colour.

**Architecture:** A static HTML page (no Jekyll front matter, copied verbatim) with one stylesheet and one ES module. Line art is generated by a Python script and inlined between markers so the nacre tile can be clipped into it. The najeon WebGL shader is used only for the cyberspace section. Everything else renders without JS.

**Tech Stack:** HTML, CSS, vanilla ES modules, inline SVG, `assets/najeon/najeon.js` (unchanged), Python 3 (art generator, fontTools for subsetting), Node 20 + Playwright (checks and screenshots), headless Chrome at `/usr/bin/google-chrome`.

## Global Constraints

- Spec: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-03-kkachi-black-ice-design.md`. Copy in §4 is final wording.
- English only. Visible copy plus tooltips ≤ 550 words.
- No hue anywhere except nacre (shader or tile). Neutral tokens from spec §3 only.
- Keep `assets/kkachi/brand/`, `assets/kkachi/icons/`, `assets/kkachi/nacre-512.webp`, `assets/najeon/` unchanged.
- Contact links: `mailto:seory0@outlook.kr`.
- Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`; pause animation off screen; work without WebGL.
- Local preview: `python3 -m http.server 8765` from the repository root, page at `http://localhost:8765/kkachi/`.
- Playwright: `PLAYWRIGHT=/data/seory0/projects/Ag3nt-Z3r0/CrayFisher/clones/openclaw-main/node_modules/playwright/index.mjs`.
- `bundle` is not installed here. The page has no front matter, so Jekyll copies it verbatim; the build check is done in CI or GitHub Pages.

### Task 5: Motion and nacre

**Files:**
- Create: `assets/kkachi/site.js`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: the hooks from Task 3 and `najeon(canvas, {animate, interactive, scale, tileUrl})` from `assets/najeon/najeon.js`, which returns `{ destroy() }`.
- Produces: no exports. Loaded with `<script type="module" src="../assets/kkachi/site.js">`.

- [ ] Lens and footer mark: a slow WAAPI drift of the clipped tile, plus pointer parallax on the lens. Off under reduced motion.
- [ ] Static panel: a random cell flicker at about 10 fps while visible.
- [ ] Cyberspace: `najeon()` on `canvas.cyber-nacre` (tile fallback `../assets/najeon/tiles/najeon-512.webp`). A 2D canvas on top paints the void and cuts out a perspective grid with `destination-out`; the grid scrolls toward the viewer while visible. Reduced motion draws one still frame.
- [ ] Run `check-page.mjs` (both runs). Expected: PASS.
- [ ] Commit: "Animate the KKACHI nacre, static, and cyberspace grid".
